forms._comment: Jotform form for each part of the website. Paste the form's ID (e.g. 251234567890123) or its full link (e.g. https://form.jotform.com/251234567890123; use the full link for EU-hosted forms). Jotform delivers submissions and email notifications. Leave blank and that page shows 'email or call us' instead. The same form can be reused for several entries. See README → Forms for the fields each form needs.

heroVideo._comment: Homepage hero background video. youtubeId plays muted and looped from YouTube (privacy-enhanced mode). Self-hosted file in public/videos/ (watermarks removed). Set mp4 to empty to show only the photo.

newHereVideo._comment: New Here page hero background video (a vertical YouTube Short, so it is cropped to fill the banner on wide screens).

communityVideo._comment: Community page hero background (Breakfast Morning 'Domi Cafe' Short). No pause control, so YouTube's title/channel overlay never appears.
